summary.business_type: YMYL health + legal service (bilingual HE/EN), medical-cannabis prescription coordination for visitors to Greece
top_findings: Six live indexable pages publish an internal 'to complete before publishing' block
Six live pages carry a visible 'not yet legally reviewed' banner whose own text says 'before publishing'
No legal entity, email, phone or postal address published anywhere indexable
refund.html directs users to write to an address that does not exist
fetchpriority=high is set on a 104.8 KB image that is not the LCP element
quick_wins: Move fetchpriority off logo-lg.webp — the LCP element is the h1
Content-hash asset filenames to allow immutable caching (currently max-age=3600)
Add legalName, address and contactPoint to Organization schema
Remove or noindex the six unfinished legal pages

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: 53/53 sitemap URLs return HTTP 200
Zero canonical errors; every page self-canonicalises to the correct apex host
Zero hreflang errors across 26 HE/EN pairs — all reciprocal, all with x-default
No orphan pages; correct lang/dir on every page
Full security header set: CSP, HSTS, COOP, CORP, X-Frame-Options, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy
Brotli on HTML and CSS; proper 404
Domain migration complete: 976 references to the new domain, zero to the old one

findings.title: Static assets cannot be cached long because filenames carry no content hash
findings.description: base.css, settings.css, a11y-widget.css, home.css and the JS files are served with max-age=3600. 61 pages share the same four stylesheets.
findings.recommendation: Content-hash the filenames, then serve max-age=31536000, immutable.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Zero filler and zero AI-writing patterns detected on every page sampled
Median 944 words, minimum 465 — no thin content anywhere
Quality scores 77–95 across sampled pages
97 outbound citations across 21 authority domains

findings.title: Internal 'to complete before publishing' blocks published on six indexable pages
findings.description: privacy.html, refund.html, terms.html and all three English counterparts are index,follow and publicly display an editorial to-do list. Verified live on the public domain.
findings.recommendation: Finish the pages, or set them to noindex until they are finished.

findings.title: 'Not yet legally reviewed' banner on live, indexable pages
findings.description: The same six pages carry a banner stating the document is a draft requiring review by a lawyer 'before publishing'. They were published.
findings.recommendation: Either complete the legal review and remove the banner, or noindex the pages.

findings.title: No legal entity or contact method published anywhere indexable
findings.description: Sitewide search returns zero email addresses, zero telephone numbers and no postal address. about.html holds these but is noindex because its 16 placeholders are unfilled. For YMYL commerce this is a strong low-quality signal under Google's quality guidelines, and likely an Israeli consumer-law requirement for a trader taking payment.
findings.recommendation: Fill about.html, remove its noindex, and extend Organization schema.

findings.title: Refund policy points to a non-existent address
findings.description: refund.html instructs users to send cancellation requests 'in writing to the address set out below'. No address is published — the to-do block sits there instead.
findings.recommendation: Publish a dedicated refund contact address.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Zero issues across all 53 crawled pages
No missing or over-length titles; no missing or mis-sized descriptions
No duplicate titles or descriptions
Exactly one h1 per page; no heading-level skips

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: 16 schema types in use, valid JSON-LD on every page, zero parse errors
FAQPage on 45 of 61 pages with 230 answers
Every FAQ answer matches its visible copy exactly

findings.title: Organization schema publishes only name and url
findings.description: No legalName, taxID, address, contactPoint or sameAs — the operating entity is unidentifiable to search engines and AI answer engines.
findings.recommendation: Extend the Organization node once about.html entity details exist.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: CLS 0
TTFB 311 ms
LCP 2008 ms — within the 2.5 s 'good' threshold
11 requests, 161.7 KB total transferred
Brotli compression; font-display:swap correctly set

findings.title: fetchpriority=high on an image that is not the LCP element
findings.description: Measured live: the LCP element is the h1 text at 2008 ms. fetchpriority=high sits on logo-lg.webp, a 104.8 KB decorative image, so high priority competes with the CSS and fonts that actually gate the largest paint.
findings.status: FIXED 2026-09-14 — attribute removed from logo-lg in 3 files

findings.title: Five render-blocking stylesheets in the head
findings.description: Four local stylesheets plus the Google Fonts request. FCP measured 2008 ms, just above the 1.8 s 'good' threshold.
findings.recommendation: Concatenate the local CSS or inline critical CSS.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: llms.txt live and fully migrated to the new domain
GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and Google-Extended explicitly allowed in robots.txt
97 outbound citations across 21 authority domains — EOF (29), gov.il (19), moh.gov.gr (11), EUDA, e-nomothesia.gr
230 FAQ answers at median 182 chars — good passage-level citability length
Machine-readable datePublished / dateModified throughout

findings.title: No identifiable author or entity weakens citability
findings.description: AI answer engines prefer attributable sources. Author is an Organization with no verifiable identity, address or contact point.
findings.recommendation: Resolve together with the about.html entity work.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Alt text present on every img element sitewide
WebP with PNG fallback via picture element
WebP already near-optimally compressed - re-encoding at safe quality saves only 3-6%
logo-lg.webp is 640px into a 400px slot: correct for 2x retina, not oversized

findings.title: logo.webp is 224px for a 70px slot in the header
findings.description: The 224px asset serves both a 95px and a 70px slot. At 2x retina the 95px use justifies 190px, so it is only marginally over; the 70px use is 3.2x. A single srcset would cover both.
findings.recommendation: Optional: add srcset with a 140px variant for the smaller slot.
